author: Shut Up & Sit Down
description:
#mechsvsminions #leagueoflegends #ad #riotgames #incredibledreamstudios

Kicking off Board Games Direct 2026 we are DELIGHTED to reveal Mechs vs. Minions: Bandle City Edition, set in the League of Legends universe, originally published by Riot Games in 2016.

Incredible Dream Studios has brought the original game back in a slimmed down and more cost effective package. The Bandle City Edition contains the same missions from the original game, and replaces the plastic minis with acrylic standees and cardboard. Adding to the content in the original game, IDS have added solo challenge puzzle cards, card dividers, skin cards with alternate-art, and more. IDS is also bringing back the Classic Edition for people wanting the original experience and plastic miniatures.

Find out more here: https://playmvm.gg

Full Let's Play of MvM:BCE with Matt and Dani can be found here: https://youtu.be/A0NYbCppsA4
